slices.title: One embodied oversized-crop harvest
slices.playerOutcome: Read one oversized crop and its soil, commit to a safer-now or riskier-later harvest plan, physically extract it through shipping input, understand why it emerged intact or damaged, and immediately face another harvest-plan decision informed by that result.
slices.primaryRisk: The slice presents crop cues and labels but resolves the harvest with a context prompt, scripted animation, opaque randomness, invisible state change, or nonpersistent reward instead of a causal physical wager.
nonGoals: Production art or imitation of another game's assets
A calendar, broad inventory, crafting tree, or economy
Multiple fields or a crop catalog
